items.reason: Bevacizumab is a D6 established GBM therapy and its own schedule is the question: 'Sintilimab ... Plus Low-dose Bevacizumab' (title), 'bevacizumab administered in a low dosage schedule'. Rule 6 makes it established_therapy_experiment, never a candidate; sintilimab stays the only candidate (experimental_monotherapy).
The only biomarker endpoint is 'To evaluate the correlative biomarkers based on TISF ctDNA', which is planned but not linked to sintilimab or PD-1; W7 assigns unclear to exactly this case.

note: Registered intervention label says 'Tislelizumab plus Bevacizumab' but every other field says sintilimab (TYVYT); both coders coded sintilimab. any_molecular_selection true because both coders code TISF ctDNA-level relapse as an enrichment biomarker defining Cohort 1 (not candidate-matched); XL may judge whether ctDNA relapse is a tumour molecular biomarker (priority 3 only).
